provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: Galois descent over Z[w3]; no search

notes: Holds for every m. With the rank-3 witness at m=2 this settles that cell exactly. Field-of-definition arguments for stabilizer rank are prior art (Lovitz and Steffan, over Q(i)); the Galois-orbit step and the Z[w3] instantiation are not.
